name: Galungan
attributedTo: EXPLAINED BY BANJAR MAS, IN THEIR WORDS
explanation: The ancestors return and we prepare for three days. Every compound in Mas is closed. This happens roughly every 210 days, and it has never moved for anyone.
availability: Nothing is bookable on these three days.

name: The day after
explanation: The offerings are still standing and the penjor are still up. Hosts who open on this day often say it is the best one to come.
availability: Three experiences open. I Made Suarta, Ibu Wayan, Pak Nyoman.

name: Kuningan
attributedTo: EXPLAINED BY BANJAR KEMENUH, IN THEIR WORDS
explanation: We finish before noon. After that the kitchen is free and Ibu Wayan has said she is happy to cook with visitors.
availability: One experience open, from two in the afternoon.
